name: Hearty yogurt and oat protein bowl
description: A no-cook bowl built for a large breakfast: plain greek yogurt thickened with rolled oats, halved strawberries folded through and scattered over, and sunflower seeds for crunch.
instructions: Stir the rolled oats into the greek yogurt and leave it to stand for 5 minutes so the oats soften.
Hull and halve the strawberries, then fold half of them through the yogurt.
Spoon into two bowls, scatter the remaining strawberries over the top and finish each bowl with the sunflower seeds.
